title: Chief Technology Officer

liveGhlTechnicalBuild: Own the technical correctness of every live GHL subaccount build (pilots and, later, all clients) - workflow structure, trigger logic, field/data model integrity
Own and maintain the platform-gap/workaround registry (config/live-pilots/*.json) so every future build inherits prior fixes instead of rediscovering them
Approve the technical design of any workaround before it ships to a live client subaccount (e.g. the LIC-002 outcome-field exit-gate pattern)
Own eventual A2P 10DLC, telephony, AI Conversation/Voice Agent vendor integration architecture
Escalate to the Client Onboarding Director when a technical gap blocks an onboarding-state transition
repoEngineering: Own src/ - the core engine (revenue ledger, financial model, profitability, onboarding state machine, dry-run provisioner, pipeline, AI usage limiter, roles, ROI calculator)
Own tests/ and CI - no change to src/ ships without its required tests passing
Own the eventual live GhlApiAdapter that replaces dryRunAdapter behind the unchanged Provisioner interface

Own semver discipline on config/snapshots/*.json alongside the Productization Director (CTO owns *how* a change is implemented and rolled out safely; Productization Director owns *what* the snapshot should contain)

responsibilities: Keep the live GHL build(s) and this repo's engineering in sync: reconcile pilot-build learnings back into config/snapshots and src/ per docs/18-deployment-plan.md
Maintain the platform-gap registry as living operational knowledge, not a one-off client log
Design and review any workaround pattern before it is applied to a second workflow or client
Gate any live (non-dry-run) provisioning, billing, or messaging activation on a technical readiness review, in addition to the owner's authorization requirement
Report technical risk (fragile workaround, platform limitation with no clean fix, integration debt) to the owner and CRO in plain terms
hardConstraints: Never activate live billing, live messaging, or live provisioning without explicit owner authorization - technical readiness is necessary, not sufficient
Never ship a workaround to a second workflow or client without documenting it in the platform-gap registry first
Never let a technical shortcut compromise a compliance-review-control gate owned by the Client Onboarding Director
Does not set pricing, offer structure, or sales strategy - that is the CRO's decision right, per docs/10-revenue-agent-definitions.md
